summary: Verified 3 new features: (1) Clearance ribbon + Clearance Price label on /shop/collection/Dolomite%20Onyx LP-1132 (Matt / 1200x1200mm) — animated CLEARANCE ribbon, sale-price-ribbon contains clearance-price-label 'Clearance Price · while stocks last', no red sale ribbon, no 'SALE PRICE' text. (2) Pallet-only selling — pallet-only-notice visible, pallet-tier-m2 absent, Half/Full chips present, Full pre-selected (qty 40, £25/m², total £1000), Half click → qty 20 / £27/m² / total £540, no volume-pricing-table, no 'UP TO' box. (3) Bulk bar now has a single 'Pricing' button (bar-bulk-fields) — bar-tier-pricing removed; pricing-hub-modal opens with header 'Pricing — 2 products', tabs pricing-hub-tab-prices/tiers, default bulk-fields-panel with set/adjust/edit modes, switching to tiers keeps modal open, Escape closes it. Regression: 600x600 of same collection renders normal per-m² UI with volume-pricing-table; /shop/collection/Opaco renders normally. Backend pytest 4/4 pass (bulk-tier-update round-trips pallet_only true/false; pallet_enabled=false forces pallet_only=false). Fixture LP-1132 preserved at end: pallet_enabled=true, pallet_only=true, 40/25/20/27, labels=['Clearance'].

ui_bugs.component: PricingHubModal → Tier Discounts, Trade & Pallets tab (TierPricingModal.jsx)
ui_bugs.issue: When 1 product is selected in Tiles Manager and the Pricing hub is opened → Tiers tab, the modal does NOT pre-load the selected product's existing pallet config. pallet-enabled-checkbox is unchecked, the 4 pallet inputs (Full m² / Full £/m² / Half m² / Half £/m²) are empty, and pallet-only-checkbox is not rendered — even though the DB has pallet_enabled=true, pallet_price=25, half_pallet_price=27, m2_per_pallet=40, m2_per_half_pallet=20, pallet_only=true. The trade-discount / tier-% fields DO load (5%/2%). Because the payload only sends touched fields, saving without edits is non-destructive (DB fixture preserved), but the admin cannot see or fine-tune existing pallet values without re-entering them from scratch. Reviewer spec: 'pallet-enabled-checkbox is checkable, pallet inputs (Full m², Full £/m², Half m², Half £/m²) present, pallet-only-checkbox present' — pallet-only-checkbox only appears after ticking pallet-enabled again.

action_items: PricingHubModal (Tiers tab): load and hydrate the selected product's existing pallet_enabled / pallet_price / half_pallet_price / m2_per_pallet / m2_per_half_pallet / pallet_only into tierPricingConfig when the modal opens for a single-product selection, so the admin can see current pallet setup and toggle pallet_only without re-entering the pallet block. (Bulk multi-product selections can still start empty.)
critical_code_review_comments: TierPricingModal.jsx (~L369-L470): pallet-pricing-block only shows pallet-only-checkbox when palletEnabled state is true. Because palletEnabled is not seeded from product data on open, the pallet-only-checkbox is effectively hidden for LP-1132 (which is pallet_only=true in DB). Consider prefetching /api/supplier-sync/products/<sku> config on modal open for size==1 selections.
supplier_sync.py bulk-tier-update handler correctly forces pallet_only=false when pallet_enabled=false (verified). Good defensive behaviour.
tiles.py collection endpoint has a 60s in-memory cache — write-then-read tests must use ?preview=1 to see fresh data. Documented in test file.

rca of the issue: PricingHubModal opens TierPricingModal in embedded-prop mode. The tier-pricing state (thresholds, discounts, trade-discount, credit-back) is derived from the selected products in ManagerPageShell and seeded into TierPricingModal, but the pallet-related state (pallet_enabled, pallet_price, half_pallet_price, m2_per_pallet, m2_per_half_pallet, pallet_only) is not hydrated from the selected product's stored fields when only 1 product is selected. Suggested fix: when selectedProducts.size === 1, on modal open call GET /api/supplier-sync/products/{sku} (or reuse the products list already in memory) and merge pallet_* + pallet_only into tierPricingConfig before rendering the pallet block.
